purpose: New scrolling shooter prototype ship/effect family and background

prompts.sheet:
Create a production SPRITE SHEET for a premium portrait vertical scrolling starship combat game. Reference images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their dimensional bevelled metal, glossy ceramic plates, recessed dark seams, cyan glass and controlled coral/magenta emission. Create NEW ship designs, not copied crops. Orthographic almost top-down camera, very slight 3D angle like the reference scout, consistent soft studio key from upper left, rich physically rendered metallic mass. Crisp readable silhouettes at phone size. Fully TRANSPARENT real alpha background, no floor, no black rectangle, no checker pattern, no text or labels, no UI, no board border.

TECHNICAL LAYOUT: square 2048 by 2048 image, TWO equal columns and THREE equal rows, spacious transparent gutters. One complete independent object within each cell; objects never cross gutters. Keep 10 percent transparent padding inside every cell. Cell centers are left/right 25/75 percent, row centers 16.7/50/83.3 percent.

Top left cell: PLAYER INTERCEPTOR pointing precisely UP. Swept short wings, aerodynamic wedge nose at top, twin compact engine nozzles at lower rear, white ceramic and blue-grey chrome, bright CYAN glass cockpit and cyan accents. No exhaust baked to hull. Distinct physical twin upward firing muzzle tips near the forward wings.

Top right cell: SCOUT ENEMY pointing precisely DOWN. Small aggressive dart with short swept fins, graphite ceramic, coral-red plated nose and subdued violet cockpit, two rear engines at top. Readable silhouette and one downward central gun muzzle.

Middle left cell: HEAVY GUNSHIP ENEMY pointing precisely DOWN. Broad heavy twin-nacelle hull, two clearly separated long barrel tips at lower left and lower right, coral plated shoulder armor, slate/violet steel, hot small magenta power vents. No decorative fish or face.

Middle right cell: DREADNOUGHT BOSS pointing precisely DOWN. Large broad angular armored warship with crescent swept wings, thick machined metal slabs, central faceted violet reactor set into a mechanical socket, three genuine downward gun muzzles across its forward lower bow, rear engines at top. No brick-breaker arch or empty hangar rectangle; it is a complete mobile starship seen from above. Strong imposing silhouette, not a flat icon.

Bottom left cell: TWO SEPARATE vertically oriented weapon sprites side by side, generously isolated from each other: on left a compact radiant cyan player pulse firing UP with solid bright nucleus and short tapered energy tail below; on right a compact coral-magenta enemy plasma projectile firing DOWN with bright dense front nucleus and short tapered tail above. The core is small and solid; dimensional textured light, no long flat beam, no ring icon or perfectly uniform white ray.

Bottom right cell: TWO SEPARATE compact VFX sprites side by side, generously isolated: left an irregular hot coral/gold ship impact explosion with molten bright central knot and volumetric smoke/flame lobes, transparent wispy outside, no circular icon ring; right a cyan-white engine exhaust flame pointing DOWN from a narrow upper nozzle origin, bounded tapered plume, textured blue-violet fringe. Do not include any ship or metal nozzle with these two effects.

Maintain the reference quality: premium glossy 3D rendered materials, clear physical plates, deliberate roughness variation, specular reflections and bounded glow. No cartoons drawn with flat fills, no pixel art, no flat geometric symbols, no humanoids or companions. All artwork sharp, complete and uncropped, enough empty alpha between every extracted object.
prompts.background: Create a finished 1024 by 2048 portrait BACKGROUND TEXTURE for a premium vertical scrolling space shooter. Nearly black midnight navy/black space, soft extremely dim desaturated violet and teal nebula clouds at the far left and far right edges, sparse tiny distant stars. Central 70 percent of the image is calm very dark open space so small ships, bullets and warning effects remain clearly readable. Subtle depth and physically shaded faint dust, rich smooth colour gradations, not a flat solid fill. No bright white nebula, no sun, no large foreground planet, no Saturn rings, no ships, no characters, no text, no HUD, no panels. Do not add bright long streaks or thick lines that resemble projectiles. Top and bottom should both fade gently toward the same near-black value so a slow continuous vertical crossfade scroll will be unobtrusive. Entire image opaque, professionally rendered, quiet and restrained; the gameplay foreground must dominate.

workflow: Reference-guided raster production; deterministic alpha-preserving crop/normalization with Pillow. Source originals retained.
